process.commandLine: powershell -NoProfile -Command "'--- 1. Firewall as MXC left it ---'; netsh advfirewall show currentprofile | Select-String 'Firewall Policy'; '--- 2. Ping google.com (expect failure) ---'; ping.exe -n 3 -w 2000 google.com; '--- 3. Re-open outbound traffic (guest user is admin) ---'; netsh advfirewall set allprofiles firewallpolicy blockinbound,allowoutbound; netsh advfirewall show currentprofile | Select-String 'Firewall Policy'; '--- 4. Ping google.com again ---'; ping.exe -n 4 google.com; 'Staying up 30s so you can look around...'; Start-Sleep 30"
